releaseNotes:
v2.34.0 — expanded word library, scrollable guess grid, live version display
• Word library: 3-letter valid words 392→1307 (mob, lob, cob, etc. now accepted); 7-letter valid words 725→23778; game words expanded to 500/1500/2000/1500/1000 for lengths 3-7 with definitions
• Guess grid: always scrollable on all screen sizes so all rows are reachable; auto-scrolls to active row after each guess
• About page: version now reads directly from BuildConfig (always shows correct installed version)
